description: Freiflächen-Photovoltaik (Potenzial) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Within the framework of the “Energy Atlas Baden-Württemberg”, a nationwide overview of open spaces that are theoretically suitable for the use of photovoltaics in accordance with the Renewable Energies Act (EEG) has been compiled. Areas along motorways and railway lines, as well as landfills and contaminated sites were taken into account. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Open-plan photovoltaics (potential)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include oac: 545, Klima, Energie. The listing shows 2018-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
